newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA BOLTON BUYS QUARRY FIRM STAKE.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA BOLTON BUYS QUARRY FIRM STAKE.

text.p: Malaysian property developer Bolton Bhd said on Tuesday it proposed to buy a 64 percent stake in a quarrying and concrete-making firm.
Bolton said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) the stake in Kenneison Brothers Sdn Bhd would cost 182.14 million ringgit in cash.
The stake would be bought from Lim Thiam Leong & Co Sdn Bhd, said Bolton.
The acquisition would trigger a mandatory general offer for the remaining shares in Kenneison not held by Bolton.
Kenneison has a quarry of around 625 acres with deposits expected to last at least 25 years, said Bolton.
The company also has two premix concrete making plants with a total capacity of 500 tonnes per hour.
Bolton said the acquisition would complement its property development activities, and that the new subsidiary could potentially be listed on the KLSE.
